source: Elias's Motion Library: Devin Jatho/Graphs cards (copied 22 Oct 2026) + saved curve presets (added 24 Oct 2026). A snapshot, not synced: re-copy after changing a curve in Motion Library.
how_to_read: AE temporal ease on 2 keys. Values are normalized: the move goes value 0->1 (or 0->100) over time 0->1, so speed is in units of the average speed |dv|/dt. Real speed for keys.velocity = speed * |dv| / dt (per dimension for multi-dim props). out_ease belongs to the first key, in_ease to the second.

graphs.name: Expo Out 1 (Elias)
graphs.description: EVERY move of an element that was off screen / not visible and becomes visible, any direction (up/down/left/right); distance and duration vary, the curve doesn't. Full speed on frame 1, then one long settle (45 % done after 10 % of the time). Elias retuned it 25 Oct 2026 (was 34.8/95.6, now the Entrance fade).

graphs.name: Entrance fade (Elias)
graphs.description: Opacity 0 → 100 of an entrance (~8 f, starting with the Expo Out 1 move). The old 'expo out graph 1' values; Elias kept them for the fade, 25 Oct 2026.

graphs.name: Launch out (Devin)
graphs.description: On screen → off screen: accelerates the whole way and leaves at full speed; match cuts.

graphs.name: Quick out, gentle land (Devin)
graphs.description: Soft entrance / slide / text reveal: close to Easy Ease, lands softer.

graphs.name: Snap in (Devin)

graphs.name: Whip (Devin)
graphs.description: Whip / slide transition (Expo In-Out (Elias) replaces it for on → on moves).

graphs.name: Reel Pop-In (Elias)
graphs.description: A reel/card pops out of a phone into place: scale + position together (10-10 S1 03, 22 Oct).

expo_in_out.name: Expo In-Out (Elias)
expo_in_out.rule: on screen -> on screen; speed 0 both sides; out = clamp(65 + 30 (s - 1), 50, 90), in = min(out + 1.5, 90) for a move of s seconds (Elias 22 Oct, formula unconfirmed)
